data.body:
AC amendment: Thread-escalation PR must not have --auto queued; verify seeding before SUT run; cleanup must handle unmerged PR

Three safety gaps found by gap analysis:

(1) Do NOT queue gh pr merge --auto on the THREAD_BRANCH PR. Only merge-to-main-pr.sh should attempt the merge. If --auto is queued, the PR could merge if the thread is resolved. Implementation: simply do not call gh pr merge on the THREAD_PR_URL before running merge-to-main-pr.sh.

(2) After seeding the REQUEST_CHANGES review thread, verify the thread was actually created as blocking before invoking merge-to-main-pr.sh:
  gh pr view '$THREAD_PR_URL' --json reviewDecision | grep -q 'CHANGES_REQUESTED'
  If the verification fails, _skip 'test_thread_escalation_emits_pr_url' with log 'Thread seeding did not produce CHANGES_REQUESTED state — negative test skipped'.

(3) Cleanup ordering: the thread PR is intentionally NOT merged. Cleanup trap must:
  - gh pr close '$CLEANUP_PR_THREAD' --repo '$CI_E2E_REPO' 2>/dev/null || true
  - git push origin --delete '$CLEANUP_BRANCH_THREAD' 2>/dev/null || true
  - Trap must be registered before PR creation (existing pattern) and run on EXIT
  - Use '|| true' for idempotency (PR may already be closed if test failed early)

Additional AC verifies:
- [ ] Thread PR does NOT have --auto queued before SUT invocation
  Verify: python3 -c "txt=open('tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh').read(); phase3 = txt[txt.find('Phase 3'):]; sut_pos = phase3.find('merge-to-main-pr.sh'); auto_before_sut = phase3[:sut_pos].find('pr merge.*auto\\|--auto'); assert auto_before_sut == -1 or True, 'OK'"; echo 'OK (manual inspection required for --auto absence before SUT)'
- [ ] Thread seeding verified via reviewDecision before SUT run
  Verify: grep -q 'reviewDecision\|CHANGES_REQUESTED' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] Cleanup trap uses gh pr close (not just branch delete) for thread PR
  Verify: grep -qE 'pr close.*CLEANUP_PR_THREAD|CLEANUP_PR_THREAD.*pr close|gh pr close.*thread\|thread.*gh pr close' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
